title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who holds a role with permission to view system settings…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view system settings but without asset access could view asset, app, and container-label metadata in Ingestion filters. This occurs because the system does not enforce asset authorization and tenant restrictions on Ingestion filter metadata. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3.
